sar.narrative: This report details suspected fraudulent online activity involving customer C05061 and card C05061-K1. Between January 12 and January 14, 2017, three unauthorized online transactions were conducted. The episode began with transaction 3660106 on January 12, 2017, for $850.28. This was followed by transaction 3660107 on January 13, 2017, for $890.79, and transaction 3660108 on January 14, 2017, for $447.95. The total exposure for this sequence of events is $2189.02. The transactions were executed using a device marked as new for this account and routed through an anonymous proxy. The activity is highly suspicious because the device fingerprint is impossible for a real device, reporting an Android handset model but running Windows 7 and Windows 10 operating systems. This indicates the use of spoofing software to mask the true origin of the transactions. The transaction model scored the final transaction at 0.292, but the impossible device signature strongly points to intentional evasion.
